negative_reviews.author: Jake Goulding
negative_reviews.text:
Horrible... so first off we chose to try here as people have said they understand allergies and understand coeliac.

We approached the server who was kind enough to tell us noodles and broths can be swapped to be as accommodating as possible. She assured us that our server will take us through the menu and help assure we are taken care of.

If that would have happened I wouldnt be writing this.

First of all, we was sat down and not a single server attended us for about 15 minutes, we was confused as we was handed a wallet at the start and all dishes apart from nagiri was containing gluten, when someone finally arrived to take orders, we had to explain our confusion and also explain that the wallet said nothing was gluten free, she explained that the vegitarian dish is the only gluten free dish... coeliacs arent rabbits!

Now this wouldnt have been a big deal but we waited for 15 minutes to have someone "help us" 15 minutes of waiting to hear they dont accommodate and have no dishes other then raw fish and a veggie ramin. Avoid here if you have an allergy!

issues: Covers dropped sharply - a heatwave with no air conditioning in the shopping centre.
Delivery preparation time running long, although accuracy and lateness were strong.
A one-star review was handled with a refund plus a complimentary meal, which does not recover the rating.
A second one-star review concerned the gluten-free offer.
Labour projections set far above actual sales, inflating the reported wage revenue percentage.
Labour well above target - shift patterns, break management and idle time.
Closing running very late after last orders, driving unnecessary labour cost.
A supervisor is stepping down to a front-of-house role and a new part-timer is starting.
Hygiene compliance lapsed on one day; a loose hand sink in the toilet has been logged.
actions: Use Deliveroo busy mode in twenty to twenty-five minute intervals and keep constant contact with the kitchen to manage wait times - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Incentivise reviews with a sticky note and a complimentary drink in delivery bags rather than compensating after a refund - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Rework the sales projections with Matt Jenner so they track actual weekly performance, and post them in the management chat - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Brief the general manager on every topic covered in the meeting - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Include the one-star review screenshot in the KPI report - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Notify the group chat of the expected closing-time standard and enforce it through the managers - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Build a sustainable management coverage plan and identify team members who can step into assistant management roles - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Additional back-of-house training following the hygiene compliance lapse - Owner: Chris B (18/08/2026)
Region-wide (South England): Report daily wage revenue from the Kobas cash logs excluding tips - tips are not business revenue - Owner: Ziang Lin (18/08/2026)

Region-wide (South England): Photograph every delivery order before hand-off and keep the images in the site's dedicated chat so refund and inaccurate-order claims can be disputed - Owner: Ziang Lin (18/08/2026)
Region-wide (South England): Evidence toilet checks with a photo posted to the team chat after each clean, verified by a manager rather than taken on trust - Owner: Ziang Lin (18/08/2026)

Region-wide (South England): Grow revenue through student fairs and local B2B outreach - visits, employee discounts and sample food drops - rather than cutting cost, which erodes quality and service - Owner: Ziang Lin (18/08/2026)
Region-wide (South England): Ensure every site is represented at the scheduled student fair events - Owner: the group (22/09/2026)
